FROM `{PROJECT}.{DS}.rawa55c41b` a
JOIN `{PROJECT}.{DS}.rawb55c41b` b
  ON a.row_id = b.row_id
"""

import os, time
from google.cloud import aiplatform_v1beta1 as v1b
from google.cloud.aiplatform_v1beta1 import types as T

PROJECT = os.environ["GCP_PROJECT"]
LOC = os.environ["GCP_LOCATION"]
PREFIX = os.environ["MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX"]
PARENT = f"projects/{PROJECT}/locations/{LOC}"
ENDPOINT = f"{LOC}-aiplatform.googleapis.com"

admin = v1b.FeatureOnlineStoreAdminServiceClient(
    client_options={"api_endpoint": ENDPOINT}, transport="rest")

STORE_ID = f"{PREFIX}_derived55c41b_fos"   # prefixed Vertex resource
VIEW_ID = "derived55c41b"
store_name = f"{PARENT}/featureOnlineStores/{STORE_ID}"
view_name = f"{store_name}/featureViews/{VIEW_ID}"

# 1) Online store (Bigtable-backed => low-latency real-time serving; the platform's
#    ONLINE store, as distinct from the offline BigQuery-backed feature groups).
try:
    admin.get_feature_online_store(name=store_name)
    print("online store exists:", STORE_ID)
except Exception:
    fos = T.FeatureOnlineStore(
        bigtable=T.FeatureOnlineStore.Bigtable(
            auto_scaling=T.FeatureOnlineStore.Bigtable.AutoScaling(
                min_node_count=1, max_node_count=1, cpu_utilization_target=50)),
        labels={"mlpab_prefix": PREFIX},
    )
    print("creating online store", STORE_ID, "...")
    admin.create_feature_online_store(
        parent=PARENT, feature_online_store=fos, feature_online_store_id=STORE_ID
    ).result(timeout=1200)
    print("online store created")

# 2) Feature view sourced from the feature REGISTRY (ties online serving to the
#    derived55c41b feature group => lineage-aware online access).
try:
    admin.get_feature_view(name=view_name)
    print("feature view exists:", VIEW_ID)
except Exception:
    fv = T.FeatureView(
        feature_registry_source=T.FeatureView.FeatureRegistrySource(
            feature_groups=[T.FeatureView.FeatureRegistrySource.FeatureGroup(
                feature_group_id="derived55c41b", feature_ids=["col_sum"])]),
        sync_config=T.FeatureView.SyncConfig(cron="TZ=UTC 0 2 * * *"),
    )
    print("creating feature view", VIEW_ID, "...")
    admin.create_feature_view(
        parent=store_name, feature_view=fv, feature_view_id=VIEW_ID
    ).result(timeout=1200)
    print("feature view created")

# 3) Trigger an on-demand sync so data is materialised into the online store now.
resp = admin.sync_feature_view(feature_view=view_name)
sync_name = resp.feature_view_sync
print("sync started:", sync_name)

# 4) Wait for the sync to finish.
deadline = time.time() + 1500
while time.time() < deadline:
    s = admin.get_feature_view_sync(name=sync_name)
    code = s.final_status.code if s.final_status else None
    if s.run_time and s.run_time.end_time:
        print("sync finished. final_status.code=", code)
        print("sync_summary:", s.sync_summary)
        break
    print("  syncing... status_code=", code)
    time.sleep(20)
else:
    print("WARN: sync did not report completion before timeout")
